verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity and share-management SaaS, where a built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an in-product AI assistant or agent that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt file only makes the site readable to external LLMs and is not an assistant inside the product; automated Companies House filing is ordinary workflow automation, not AI delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
